english.title: Provide / arrange a relevant service for a student in relation to a relevant assignment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(1) and (2) of the Skills and Post-16 Education Act 2022.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
provided a relevant service / arranged for a relevant service to be provided
to a student
in relation to a relevant assignment

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) It is a defence for the person to prove that they did not know, and could not with reasonable diligence have known, that if material was provided to the student as a result of the relevant service, that the student would, or might, use the material in completing all or part of the assignment (see section 27(3) and (4)(a) of the Skills and Post-16 Education Act 2022).(ii) It is a defence for the person to prove that they did not know, and could not with reasonable diligence have known, that the student was required to complete the assignment personally (see section 27(3) and (4)(b) of the Skills and Post-16 Education Act 2022).(iii) It is a defence for the person to prove that they did not know, and could not with reasonable diligence have known, that the relevant service was not permitted assistance (see section 27(3) and (4)(c) of the Skills and Post-16 Education Act 2022).
(iv) Section 29 provides for the involvement of bodies corporate and unincorporated associations in the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
